lines.en: label chikaspring6:
scene noonsky
Since the dawn of time, human beings have striven for one thing and one thing only — a place where all is bright and beautiful. And in the 1970’s, we finally found it.
lines.zh: 自亘古以来，人类就只为一件事而奋斗——一个光明而美好的地方。而在 1970 年代，我们终于找到了它。

lines.en: What I’m speaking of is, of course, the maid cafe. Which, believe it or not, was actually first conceived in the US.
lines.zh: 我说的当然是女仆咖啡厅。信不信由你，它最早其实是在美国被构想出来的。

lines.en: And it would remain there for roughly three decades until Japan finally got its hands on it and turned it into the ever-growing empire it is to this day.
lines.zh: 而它在那里延续了约三十年，直到日本终于接手，把它打造成了今天这个不断扩张的帝国。

lines.en: Tonight, that’s where I’ll be going. But it’s not just because I am a pervert. It’s not just because I’m bad with money. It’s not just because I’m adept at talking to girls either.
lines.zh: 今晚，我就要去那儿。但这不是只因为我是变态。不只是因为我不会管钱。也不只是因为我擅长跟女孩搭讪。

lines.en: It’s because I am all of those things at once. Which, as I’m sure you don’t understand since you are weak, is essentially required to survive a place like a maid cafe — where cute girls prowl the room like lions.
lines.zh: 而是因为我集所有这些于一身。这一点你肯定不懂，因为你太弱——可这在女仆咖啡厅这种地方是生存必需的，那里可爱的女孩们像狮子一样在房间里巡游。

lines.en: We, my friend, are meant to be their meals. But tonight? Tonight, I will feast upon them. And I will show them what humans are truly capable of.
lines.zh: 朋友，我们生来就是她们的盘中餐。但今晚？今晚，我要反过来享用她们。我要让她们见识人类真正的能耐。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid1
Oh god, there are two of them. I’m done for.
lines.zh: 哦天，有两个人。我完了。

lines.en: : Sensei! Hi! Welcome in!
lines.zh: : Sensei！嗨！欢迎光临！

lines.en: : Not Sensei, Chika-chan! This precious prince goes only by “Master” within these sacred walls!
lines.zh: : 不能叫 Sensei，Chika 酱！在这神圣的围墙之内，这位尊贵的王子只能叫「主人」！

lines.en: : Right! Of course!
lines.zh: : 对哦！当然！

lines.en: scene chikathemaid2
: Thanks so much for coming, Master! We’ve been eagerly awaiting your arrival!
lines.zh: : 非常感谢您的光临，主人！我们一直热切期盼您的到来！

lines.en: : That’s right, Chika-chan! And we’re super-duper excited to take extra good care of you today!
lines.zh: : 没错，Chika 酱！我们超级无敌期待今天能好好服侍您！

lines.en: : I would like to place an order for takeout.
lines.zh: : 我要点一份外带。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid3
: Do we even do that here?
lines.zh: : 我们这儿有外带服务吗？

lines.en: : I think Master is implying that he wants to take us home.
lines.zh: : 我想主人的意思是要把我们带回家。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid4
: Then yes! You may place your order right now! Free of charge! But why wait until you get home when you can have us right here in the maid cafe?!
lines.zh: : 那可以！您现在就点吧！完全免费！不过干嘛要等回到家——在这儿就能享用我们呀？！

lines.en: : Because, Chika-chan, that is something that we in the business call “illegal.”
lines.zh: : 因为，Chika 酱，那在我们这行叫「违法」。

lines.en: : It’s only illegal if you get caught! Right, Master?
lines.zh: : 被抓住才算违法！对吧，主人？

lines.en: : Right. I’ll be taking Chika as my entree and Uta as dessert.
lines.zh: : 对。我要 Chika 当主菜，Uta 当甜点。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid5
: And what would you like as an appetizer, Master? Might I recommend our brand new blueberry banana brownie batter baumkuchen?
lines.zh: : 那您要什么前菜呢，主人？要不要试试我们新出的蓝莓香蕉布朗尼面糊年轮蛋糕？

lines.en: : That’s too many B’s. I’ll just take Osako.
lines.zh: : 名字太长了。我就要 Osako 吧。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid6
: I think Osako-chan is off limits to everybody but precious princesses.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Osako 酱只对尊贵的公主们开放哦。

lines.en: : Just put a mask on her and tell her I’m Wakana. It’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 给她戴个面具，跟她说我是 Wakana。没事的。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid7
: Aah! Bad Master! You are bringing dark energy into a place of joy and love! Don’t force Uta-chan to cast her infamous death beam on you!
lines.zh: : 啊！坏主人！你把黑暗能量带进了这个充满欢乐与爱的地方！别逼 Uta 酱对你放出她那有名的死亡光线！

lines.en: : Sen...Master! You’re gonna pick me, right?! Do I get to serve you today?! I do, right?! Right?! RIGHT?!?!?!
lines.zh: : Sen……主人！你会选我的对吧？！今天能让我服侍您吧？！可以吧？！对吧？！对吧？！？！

lines.en: scene chikathemaid8
: Oh, Chika-chan. You sweet summer child. This master is Uta-chan’s number one customer. He chooses her without fail any time he has the option.
lines.zh: : 哦，Chika 酱。你这个天真的孩子。这位主人可是 Uta 酱的头号客人。只要有得选，他每次都毫无例外地选她。

lines.en: : And how could he not? Uta-chan is the ultimate male fantasy of course.
lines.zh: : 他怎么会不选呢？Uta 酱可是男性幻想的终极形态。

lines.en: : I choose Chika.
lines.zh: : 我选 Chika。

lines.en: : See? Without fail. Every-
lines.zh: : 看吧？毫无例外。每次——

lines.en: scene chikathemaid9
: Yay! I knew it! I knew Master would choose me!
lines.zh: : 耶！我就知道！我就知道主人会选我！

lines.en: I’m sorry, Uta-chan...but this is for your own good.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Uta 酱……但这是为你好。

lines.en: : I MEAN...MASTER!!!!
lines.zh: : 我是说……主人！！！！

lines.en: scene chikathemaid10
: Don’t worry, Uta-chan! I’m sure you’d be his first pick if I wasn’t working! And if money’s the problem, I’ll split his bill with you as a special thanks for being so darn cute!
lines.zh: : 别担心，Uta 酱！要不是我上班，你肯定是他的首选！要是钱的问题，他的账单我跟你分，就当是特别感谢你这么可爱！

lines.en: : You look really upset right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在看起来好沮丧。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid11
: Uta-chan is fine! Albeit mildly betrayed! But that’s okay because she’s going to make Master pay for it somehow!
lines.zh: : Uta 酱没事！虽然有点被背叛的感觉！但没关系，因为她总会想办法让主人为此付出代价！

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 怎么做？

lines.en: : Yeah, how? I am also suddenly very intrigued.
lines.zh: : 对啊，怎么做？我也突然很好奇。

lines.en: : That’s for you to know and...wait, I said it wrong. That’s for Uta-chan to know and you to find out! Ha!
lines.zh: : 这得你来知道然后……等等，我说反了。这得 Uta 酱知道，而你去发现！哈！

lines.en: : You...sure you’re okay, Uta-chan?
lines.zh: : 你……真没事吗，Uta 酱？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid12
: More than okay, Chika-chan. Because it just so happens that I have decided to dine with Master today! And you will be serving both of us!
lines.zh: : 好得很，Chika 酱。因为刚好，我决定今天也跟主人一起用餐！而你要服侍我们俩！

lines.en: : Yay! Double money!
lines.zh: : 耶！双倍收入！

lines.en: : Uta-chan eats free.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱免单。

lines.en: : Boo! Single money!
lines.zh: : 切！单倍收入！

lines.en: : Well, I guess I didn’t have to wait long to figure out how you were going to make me pay.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来我不用等多久就知道你要怎么让我付钱了。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid13
: Oh, this is just the beginning. Uta-chan is going to make you pay for this transgression for years to come. You will regret this choice, Master. Mark my words.
lines.zh: : 哦，这只是开始。Uta 酱要让你为这次冒犯付出代价，付出好多年。你会后悔这个选择的，主人。记住我的话。

lines.en: : Uhhhh...
: Come on, Sen...Master! Let’s get you seated and taken care of!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Sen……主人！我带您入座，好好服侍您！

lines.en: scene black
: In the locker room!
lines.zh: : 在更衣室里！

lines.en: : Bad, Chika-chan! Are you trying to turn this place into a blueberry banana brownie batter brothel?!
lines.zh: : 坏孩子，Chika 酱！你想把这地方变成蓝莓香蕉布朗尼面糊妓院吗？！

lines.en: : Buuuuuut don’t you think this master deserves a little special treatment? Huuuuuuh?
lines.zh: : 但————是，你不觉得这位主人值得一点特殊待遇吗？嗯————？

lines.en: Chika grabs my arm and all I can hope is that Uta’s anti-sexual contact forcefield is weak today.
lines.zh: Chika 抓住我的胳膊，我只能祈祷 Uta 的「反性接触力场」今天弱一点。

lines.en: : No touching! Bad! Bad, Chika-chan!
lines.zh: : 不许碰！坏！坏，Chika 酱！

lines.en: Ugh. It’s not. It’s just as annoyingly strong as always.
lines.zh: 唉。没用。还是跟平常一样烦人地强。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid14
Regardless of the lack of hot locker room maid sex, I still do get to order and be treated like a prince.
lines.zh: 尽管没有火辣的女仆更衣室性爱，但我还是能点餐、被当成王子伺候。

lines.en: But apparently, Chika is not yet trained in the art of the flavor beam, so it’s just a normal...huge omelet served to me by a cute girl.
lines.zh: 不过显然，Chika 还没学会「美味光线」这门手艺，所以这就是普通的……由一个可爱女孩端上来的一份巨大蛋包饭。

lines.en: Granted, it’s a cute girl who, just like in the bedroom, is eager and ready to do whatever I say.
lines.zh: 不过好歹是个可爱女孩，跟在卧室里一样，热切又随时愿意听候我吩咐。

lines.en: And it brings me comfort knowing she would gladly suck me off beneath the table in uniform if only this was a blueberry banana brownie batter brothel.
lines.zh: 而想到只要这儿是家蓝莓香蕉布朗尼面糊妓院，她就会穿着制服欣然在桌子底下给我口交，我就感到安心。

lines.en: : Is there anything else I can get for you, Master? Osako-chan’s oolong tea is to die for! And that bluebanberobthbaumukuchen
lines.zh: : 您还要点什么吗，主人？Osako 酱的乌龙茶超——好喝！还有那个蓝莓香蕉布朗尼面糊年轮蛋糕——

lines.en: : Say it right! That was way too quiet and way too wrong!
lines.zh: : 好好说！你刚才太小声了，完全不对！

lines.en: : Baumkuchen! It’s good!
lines.zh: : 年轮蛋糕！超好吃！

lines.en: : Tch. Ami-chan was right. I guess that is too many B’s.
lines.zh: : 啧。Ami 酱说得对。这名字确实太长了。

lines.en: : Is she here tonight? Can you tell her I’m-
lines.zh: : 她今晚在吗？你能帮我告诉她我——

lines.en: : Nope! No Ami here! Just Chika-chan! So it’s time for you to pay attention to her!
lines.zh: : 没有！Ami 不在这儿！只有 Chika 酱！所以你现在该把注意力放在她身上！

lines.en: : Ahem. Chika-chan? You seem to have skipped my order. I would like one blueberry-
lines.zh: : 咳咳。Chika 酱？你好像把我的单漏了。我要一份蓝莓——

lines.en: scene chikathemaid15
: One blueberry, coming right up!
lines.zh: : 一份蓝莓，马上来！

lines.en: : You better bring me more than one blueberry, woman! This type of service would be unacceptable if Uta-chan had a penis!
lines.zh: : 你最好给我上的不止一颗蓝莓，女人！要是 Uta 酱有鸡巴，这种服务根本说不过去！

lines.en: : If Uta-chan had a penis, I probably wouldn’t be her number one customer.
lines.zh: : 要是 Uta 酱有鸡巴，我大概就不是她的头号客人了。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid16
: Yeah well, you’re not anymore. You’ve been demoted. Uta-chan’s number one customer always picks Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 是哦，那你现在已经不是了。你被降级了。Uta 酱的头号客人总是选 Uta 酱。

lines.en: : Can I make it up to you by marrying you instead?
lines.zh: : 那我娶你作为补偿行吗？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid17
: Fine. Ring please.
lines.zh: : 行。戒指拿来。

lines.en: : I don’t have one on me.
lines.zh: : 我身上没带。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid16
: All talk like always. How predictable.
lines.zh: : 又只会耍嘴皮子。一如既往。真没新意。

lines.en: : You’re not, like...actually mad at me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会……真的生我气了吧？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid18
: Noooooo...
: You totally are.
lines.zh: : 你绝对在生气。

lines.en: : Uta-chan is just jealous. That’s all. But she understands that Chika-chan can be unpredictable at times and is just going to hope that you’re only doing this so nobody gets hurt.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱只是嫉妒而已。就这样。不过她理解 Chika 酱有时会让人捉摸不透，她只希望你这么做是为了不让任何人受伤。

lines.en: : That’s exactly it. She seems kind of...okay in here, though. Apart from all the begging and...probably preparing you a single blueberry thing.
lines.zh: : 就是这个。不过她在这儿看起来挺……正常的。除了老是求人和……大概正在给你准备一颗蓝莓什么的。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid19
: Yeah, she actually fits in great here. She’s number two right after me now. Like, the gap is still pretty substantial. But she definitely has her fans.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她在这儿其实混得挺好。现在排我后面第二名。不过差距还挺大的。但她确实有自己的粉丝。

lines.en: : Does she? I didn’t realize that many people would be into the whole maid gyaru archetype thing.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我都不知道有那么多人吃「女仆辣妹」这一套。

lines.en: : Gyaru? No. Chika went with a different archetype.
lines.zh: : 辣妹？不是。Chika 走的是另一套。

lines.en: : Did she? She didn’t seem to be putting on a character for me at all.
lines.zh: : 是吗？她对我好像一点都没在演。

lines.en: : Yeah, because it’s you. Just look at how she treats the other customers, though.
lines.zh: : 对，因为是你。不过你看看她怎么对其他客人的。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid20
: C-C-C-Chika-chan!
lines.zh: : C——C——C——Chika 酱！

lines.en: : Hi! Do you need something?
lines.zh: : 嗨！您要点什么吗？

lines.en: : We...um...we were thinking about maybe...asking Uta-chan to...serve us...n...next time...
lines.zh: : 我们……呃……我们在想……下次能不能……让 Uta 酱……来服侍我们……

lines.en: : Oh God...her eyes...here it comes...
lines.zh: : 哦天……她的眼神……要来了……

lines.en: : So you’re going to leave me all alone?...
lines.zh: : 所以你们要把我一个人丢下？……

lines.en: : Mnh...
: You realize this is my job, right?...
lines.zh: : 你知道这是我的工作，对吧？……

lines.en: : Should I just starve and die? Is that what you want? You want Chika-chan to die?!
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该饿死算了？你是不是就想这样？你想让 Chika 酱死掉？！

lines.en: : You’d never do that to me, right?! You love Chika-chan! Don’t you?! You love me, don’t you?! Tell me you love me! Say it! Say it, say it!
lines.zh: : 你不会那样对我的，对吧？！你爱 Chika 酱！对吧？！你爱我，对不对？！说你爱我！快说！快说嘛，快说！

lines.en: : W-We love you, Chika-chan! We love you!
lines.zh: : 我——我们爱你，Chika 酱！我们爱你！

lines.en: : W-We were only kidding about...asking for someone else!
lines.zh: : 我——我们刚才是开玩笑的……不会找别人的！

lines.en: : Good! Because you don’t want to know what I would have done to you if you weren’t. Your parents wouldn’t even be able to recognize you.
lines.zh: : 很好！因为你们不会想知道你们要是认真的话我会对你们做什么。你们爸妈都会认不出你们。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid21
: It’s all because I love you, though! And I can’t wait to stay together forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever and if you ever look at another girl I will cut you into pieces!
lines.zh: : 不过这都因为我爱你们！我好想跟你们永远永远永远永远永远永远在一起，要是你们敢多看别的女孩一眼，我就把你们切成碎片！

lines.en: : Hahahah! Whoops! Just kidding!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！哎呀！开玩笑的啦！

lines.en: scene chikathemaid22
: Never fucking joke with me like that again. Got it? Good. Die, you fucking pigs.
lines.zh: : 别再他妈跟我开这种玩笑。听清了吗？很好。去死吧，你们这群猪。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid23
: Uhh...sorry about that. Chika-chan is-
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉。Chika 酱她——

lines.en: : She called us pigs!
lines.zh: : 她管我们叫猪！

lines.en: : She told us to die! Did you hear that?!
lines.zh: : 她叫我们去死！你听见了吗？！

lines.en: scene chikathemaid24
: Oh.
: Yeah. Apparently, a lot of girls are just really into that. Either that or they just fear for their lives. But any first-timer who’s ever been served by Chika has never asked for anyone else.
lines.zh: : 是啊。显然好多女孩就吃这一套。要么就是因为怕死。但凡是 Chika 服务过的客人，没有一个再点过别人。

lines.en: : Not like I’m gonna complain, though. If it works, it works. She’s clearly got a thing.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不打算抱怨。管用就行。她显然有一套。

lines.en: : Yeah...I think I like your style a little more. Fearing for my life doesn’t really do it for me most of the time.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我还是更喜欢你的风格。大部分时间我可不想提心吊胆过日子。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid25
: She’s okay though, right? Like...that’s not actually something we should be worried about her saying to customers.
lines.zh: : 不过她没事吧？我是说……她对客人说这种话，我们是不是该担心一下。

lines.en: : Master?
lines.zh: : 主人？

lines.en: : Master, are you in danger? Blink once for yes and twice for no.
lines.zh: : 主人，您有危险吗？眨眼一下表示有，两下表示没有。

lines.en: : How many more years until we can move to Nara together?
lines.zh: : 还要过多少年我们才能一起搬去奈良？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid26
: D-Don’t make my heart hurt at work, dummy! Uta-chan needs to look presentable and I can already feel myself getting hot!
lines.zh: : 别——别在上班的时候让我心跳加速，笨蛋！Uta 酱得保持体面，而我已经感觉自己热起来了！

lines.en: : Well, you better not be getting hot for my master, Uta-chan!
lines.zh: : 哼，你最好别是为我家主人发情，Uta 酱！

lines.en: scene chikathemaid27
: One very special blueberry for a very special girl! Where would you like it? Shall I feed it to you myself?
lines.zh: : 一颗特别的蓝莓，献给特别的你！你想让它去哪儿？要我亲自喂你吗？

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: : Chika. You are fired.
lines.zh: : Chika。你被开除了。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid28
: Should I just starve and die?...
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该饿死算了？……

lines.en: : Is that what you want? You want Chika-chan to die?! Is that it, Uta?! HUH?!
lines.zh: : 你是不是就想这样？你想让 Chika 酱死掉？！是不是啊，Uta？！啊？！

lines.en: scene black
: I just want dessert! Why can’t you treat me like Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 我只是想要甜点！你为什么就不能像对 Sensei 那样对我？！

lines.en: : His...name...is...MASTER! YOU WILL ADDRESS HIM AS SUCH OR I WILL TELL HIM ABOUT THE TIME YOU ALMOST KISSED AMI!
lines.zh: : 他的……名字……是……主人！你必须这么称呼他，不然我就把你差点亲了 Ami 的事告诉他！

lines.en: : The time you what?
lines.zh: : 你差点什么？

lines.en: : PHPHPHBHBHHBHAAAA!!!! NOTHING!!! SHE’S MAKING THAT UP, MASTER! UTA-CHAN ONLY HAS EYES FOR YOU!
lines.zh: : 噗噗噗啊啊啊！！！！没有的事！！！她瞎编的，主人！UTA 酱眼里只有您！

lines.en: : KEEP YOUR EYES OFF OF MY MASTER!!!!
lines.zh: : 把你眼睛从我家主人身上移开！！！！

lines.en: : Um! C-Chika-chan! We’re ready for our b-
lines.zh: : 那个！C——Chika 酱！我们想点——

lines.en: : WHEN DID I GIVE YOU PERMISSION TO SPEAK!?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候允许你说话了！？

lines.en: : W-W-W-We’re sorry!!!!!!!
So yeah, I think it’s probably safe to say that Chika has gone off the deep end.
lines.zh: 总之，我觉得可以相当有把握地说，Chika 已经彻底失控了。

lines.en: Which...was probably safe to say quite a while ago.
lines.zh: 虽然……这早就可以这么说了。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid29
But there are moments every now and then where her true self peeks out again. And those are the moments I hope for every time I go out of my way to see her.
lines.zh: 但偶尔还是会有她真实的自我探出头的时刻。而我每次特意去看她，期待的就是这种时刻。

lines.en: I still love her at the end of the day. And if I’m not able to do that just because she’s a little bit broken now, how am I supposed to expect anyone to ever love me?
lines.zh: 归根结底我还是爱她的。要是因为她现在有点破碎我就做不到这一点，那我凭什么指望别人来爱我？

lines.en: This rings especially true when I remember I’m the one who cracked her in the first place. I just can’t really see any of the damage when she looks at me with eyes like those.
lines.zh: 当我记起是我亲手把她敲碎的时候，这句话尤其真切。只是当她用那样的眼神看我时，我实在看不出任何裂痕。

lines.en: : I am so glad you came to see me at work today. It was nice getting to serve somebody I actually like for a change.
lines.zh: : 真高兴你今天来上班的地方看我。能服侍一个我真正喜欢的人，感觉真好。

lines.en: : Yeah...you seemed pretty harsh on those two girls back there.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你刚才对那两个女孩好像挺凶的。

lines.en: : That’s because they look at me with eyes that only you should look at me with. The hungry kind. Like they want to devour me whole.
lines.zh: : 因为她们看我的眼神，是那种只该有的眼神。饥渴的那种。好像想把我整个吞掉。

lines.en: : And it would be fine if I devoured you then?
lines.zh: : 那要换我来吞掉你，就没问题？

lines.en: : You can devour me whenever you want. And I’m not just the entree, Sensei. I’m a full three-course meal.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候想吞我都行。而且我不只是主菜，Sensei。我是完整的全套三道菜。

lines.en: : Well, you definitely look great in the uniform.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你穿这身制服确实很好看。

lines.en: : And yet a certain someone still hasn’t gotten to experience what it’s like to take it off of me.
lines.zh: : 可某个人到现在都还没体验过把它从我身上脱下来的滋味。

lines.en: : One day, sure. Not tonight though, if that’s what you’re getting at.
lines.zh: : 总有一天会的。不过今晚不行，如果这是你的意思。

lines.en: : Why not? There’s a karaoke place on the way back to my apartment that I’ve heard basically no one ever monitors.
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？回我公寓的路上有家卡拉 OK，听说基本上从来没人查。

lines.en: : Yeah...definitely not a karaoke place. I don’t have a good track record with those.
lines.zh: : 是啊……反正不是卡拉 OK。我跟那地方前科不太好。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid30
: I didn’t realize you’d...done stuff there with other girls.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你……跟别的女孩在那儿做过那种事。

lines.en: : Chika, can we talk?
lines.zh: : Chika，我们能谈谈吗？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid31
: Please don’t break up with me.
lines.zh: : 求你别跟我分手。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Everyone’s telling me I’m going crazy. But I don’t feel crazy. So if you think I’m going crazy too, just...I don’t know. Please don’t break up with me, though. I’m really trying. Really.
lines.zh: : 所有人都说我疯了。可我自己不觉得疯。所以要是你也觉得我疯了，那就……我不知道。但求你别跟我分手。我真的很努力。真的。

lines.en: : Who have you heard that from? That you’re going crazy. Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你听谁说你疯了？Yumi 吗？

lines.en: : Plus Rin. And the girls at the maid cafe. Hell, even Sana’s pointed it out and I barely even know her.
lines.zh: : 还有 Rin。还有女仆咖啡厅的女孩们。见鬼，连 Sana 都这么说，而我跟她根本不熟。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...Sana’s not the most particularly sane person either, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……我觉得 Sana 自己也不算特别正常。

lines.en: : And it’s not just because I’m seeing love the way you do now, right? Like...there’s more to it than that. There has to be, right? Because no one calls you insane for thinking that way. Why me? Why-
lines.zh: : 而且这不只是因为我现在用你看待爱的方式看待爱了，对吧？肯定……不止是这样。一定还有别的，对吧？因为没人会因为那么想就说你疯了。为什么是我？为什么——

lines.en: : Chika...you really don’t need to try and adapt to my way of thinking if you’re struggling with it.
lines.zh: : Chika……你要是觉得很吃力，真的不用勉强自己适应我的想法。

lines.en: : No, I do. Because the alternative is me finding out you’ve been cheating on me with a million other people and...I don’t...
lines.zh: : 不，我要。因为不然就是我得面对你跟无数别人出轨的事实，而……我不……

lines.en: : I don’t think you understand what that would do to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不明白那会把我怎么样，Sensei。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid32
: So you’d rather I just...what? Keep you in the dark forever?
lines.zh: : 那你宁愿我……怎样？永远瞒着你？

lines.en: : I’d rather you love just me and only me. And I get that you don’t. I obviously get that. It just...fucking sucks. Like, I don’t even know who else you’ve been with. I feel so...ignored. And just...all around shitty.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿你只爱我一个人。我也明白你做不到。我显然明白。只是……他妈的太难受了。我都不知道你还跟谁在一起过。我觉得自己好……被无视。整个人都……糟透了。

lines.en: : Yet, you’re desperate for me to not break up with you.
lines.zh: : 可你又拼了命不想让我跟你分手。

lines.en: : Hurting with you beats hurting alone.
lines.zh: : 跟你一起痛，总好过一个人痛。

lines.en: : You’re not alone, Chika. There are plenty of other people with more love to offer you than I can.
lines.zh: : 你并不孤单，Chika。还有很多人能给你比我更多的爱。

lines.en: : Well, what if I took it all?
lines.zh: : 那，要是我全都要了呢？

lines.en: : What?...
: Would you be able to stay with me if I did the same thing you do? And love other people?
lines.zh: : 要是我跟你做一样的事，也爱别人，你还能跟我在一起吗？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid33
: It’s not my place to tell you what you can and can’t do.
lines.zh: : 我没资格告诉你什么能做、什么不能做。

lines.en: : But it is your place to tell me how it would make you feel!
lines.zh: : 但你有资格告诉我这会让你有什么感受！

lines.en: : I have given you everything. Not just my body and my heart, but my family. I have cried more tears for you at this point than I did for my fucking father when he walked out on me. That means something.
lines.zh: : 我把一切都给了你。不只是身体和心，还有我的家人。事到如今我为你流的泪，比我那混蛋父亲抛弃我时流的还多。这是有分量的。

lines.en: : So yeah. I am going to force myself to change if you need me to do that in order to live with the guilt that I know you have for hurting me. But I need you to give me something too. I deserve that.
lines.zh: : 所以没错。要是你需要我改变，好让你能带着「伤害了我」的愧疚活下去，我会逼自己改变。但你也得给我点什么。这是我应得的。

lines.en: : What do you want, Chika?...
lines.zh: : 你想要什么，Chika？……

lines.en: : I can’t just stop being the way I am. If I could, I’d have done it already.
lines.zh: : 我没法就这么改掉自己的本性。要是我能，早就改了。

lines.en: : I need you...to need me.
lines.zh: : 我需要你……也需要我。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid34
: It’s that simple.
lines.zh: : 就这么简单。

lines.en: : I can handle the love thing. I can make myself believe it. And...
lines.zh: : 爱这事我能扛住。我能逼自己相信。而且……

lines.en: scene chikathemaid35
: Maybe, I’ve...kind of...already started to.
lines.zh: : 也许我……已经……开始有点了。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid36
: But there’s still this huge void in my chest that feels like it’s getting wider every single day, and you’re the one I want to fill it.
lines.zh: : 但我胸口还有个巨大的空洞，感觉每天都在变大，而我想让你来填满它。

lines.en: : Chika...why are you betting everything on the first person you’ve ever fallen for? A depraved and depressed teacher, no less. You’re so much smarter than this. Smarter than me.
lines.zh: : Chika……你为什么要把一切押在你第一个爱上的人身上？而且还是个堕落又抑郁的老师。你比这聪明多了。比我聪明。

lines.en: : Words can’t explain it.
lines.zh: : 这没法用语言解释。

lines.en: : You just have to believe me when I say it has to be you...or no one at all.
lines.zh: : 你只要相信我说的——必须是你……不然就谁都不要。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid37
: I’m sorry for just...springing this on you. Things have been weird lately and it’s all just...coming out.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……就这么突然倒给你了。最近一切都怪怪的，然后就……全涌出来了。

lines.en: : No, it’s fine...this is what I wanted when I told you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 没事……这正是我一开始告诉你时想要的。

lines.en: : You only told me at all because you had to or I was going to kill Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你当时告诉我，只是因为不得不告诉，不然我就要杀了 Yumi。

lines.en: : Well, what do you want me to do now then? Give you every single detail? Weigh in on what I’d really do if you followed in my footsteps? How do I fix this?
lines.zh: : 那你现在要怎样？要我把每个细节都告诉你？说说你要是学我我会怎么做？我该怎么补救？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid38

lines.zh: : 所以……

lines.en: : You’re not going to break up with me then?
lines.zh: : 你不打算跟我分手了？

lines.en: : I don’t have the fucking balls to break up with anyone.
lines.zh: : 我他妈根本没胆子跟任何人分手。

lines.en: : And even if I did...you’re...
lines.zh: : 而且就算我有……你也……

lines.en: : Special...I guess.
lines.zh: : 很特别的……我想。

lines.en: scene chikathemaid39
: Mm.
: I’m winning...
lines.zh: : 我赢了……

lines.en: : Can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : 我能问你个事吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I can’t guarantee my answer won’t just make everything worse, though.
lines.zh: : 可以。不过我不保证我的回答不会让事情更糟。

lines.en: : If I was never in your class...and just some girl you met maybe five...ten years from now...
lines.zh: : 要是我从没进过你的班……只是你五年……十年后遇到的某个女孩……

lines.en: : Do you think you’d ask me for my number?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你会问我要电话吗？

lines.en: scene chikathemaid40
: ...I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : ……我没懂。

lines.en: : Me neither.
lines.zh: : 我也没懂。

lines.en: : I just want to know.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道。

lines.en: : I’m...not really sure. I think the...context would probably matter? Asking someone for their number out of nowhere is a little weird, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定。我觉得……场景可能很重要？平白无故问别人要电话，有点怪吧？

lines.en: : Fair. I think I’d ask for yours before you even had a chance to anyway.
lines.zh: : 也是。不过我想你会还没来得及问，我就先问你了。

lines.en: : Yeah well, your feelings for me are clearly stronger than mine since they’re only aimed at one person instead of everyone you’ve ever met. Of course you’d win out in that scenario.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你对我的感情显然比我对你的强——因为你的只对准我一个人，而我的却撒向所有我见过的人。那当然是你赢了。

lines.en: : Assuming you don’t already have a boyfriend in this make believe world five or ten years from now.
lines.zh: : 假设在那个五年或十年后的假想世界里，你还没有男朋友的话。

lines.en: : Who says I wouldn’t have a girlfriend instead?
lines.zh: : 谁说我不会有个女朋友呢？

lines.en: : Your track record of sleeping with only men.
lines.zh: : 你只跟男人上床的前科。

lines.en: : And if I had a secret lesbian tryst behind your back? Would your opinion of me change at all?
lines.zh: : 要是我背着你偷偷跟女生好上了呢？你对我的看法会变吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think you’d be way cooler.
lines.zh: : 会。我觉得你会酷得多。

lines.en: scene black
: But I’d also never forgive you for not inviting me.
lines.zh: : 但我也永远不会原谅你不叫上我。

lines.en: : Hahah! I’ll keep that in mind for next time.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！下次我会记住的。

lines.en: : Next time?
lines.zh: : 下次？

lines.en: : I’m a baaaaaad girl, Sensei! Really just following in your footsteps. Always horny and always open for business!
lines.zh: : 我是个坏————女孩，Sensei！简直就是学你的样！永远饥渴，永远营业！

lines.en: : Mhm. Right. So you just want me to think you’re cool.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这样。所以你就是想让我觉得你很酷。

lines.en: : Maaaaaybe! I’ll just have to keep you in the dark, though. For your own good, of course.
lines.zh: : 也许吧————！不过我得一直瞒着你。当然是为了你好。

lines.en: : Is that what you want me to do then? Just...never bring this up again? Let you keep living your monogamous fantasy life where you’re always winning and always blissfully ignorant?
lines.zh: : 那你就想让我这样？……再也不提这事？让你继续做你的一夫一妻美梦，永远赢、永远天真无知？

lines.en: : Heheh...maaaaaybe.
: That’s a serious question, Chika. I want to avoid hurting you however I can. Just-
lines.zh: : 我是认真的，Chika。我想尽一切办法避免伤害你。只是——

lines.en: : Just without changing who you are.
lines.zh: : 只是不改变你自己。

lines.en: : Leave the changing to me, Sensei...I’m young. I still can.
lines.zh: : 改变的事交给我，Sensei……我还年轻。我还来得及。

lines.en: : I hate that I’m doing this to you.
lines.zh: : 我恨自己这样对你。

lines.en: : I think you love that you’re doing this to me. Otherwise, you’d go after girls your own age.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你爱这样对我。不然你就会去找同龄的女孩了。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe you are actually cool. That’s a level of sass I fully deserve.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许你确实挺酷的。这嘴毒的程度我完全受得起。

lines.en: : If you think I’m cool now, you should see me at karaoke.
lines.zh: : 你要觉得我现在酷，那你是没见过我唱卡拉 OK。

lines.en: : I already told you, no sex tonight.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，今晚不做爱。

lines.en: : But there’s no better time to have sex than right after talking your feelings out! I wanna do it! Pleeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 可没有什么时候比把心里话都说开之后更适合做爱了！我想做！求————你了？

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeeeease?
: Not tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚不行。

lines.en: : I feel like this is a good place to leave things.
lines.zh: : 我觉得到这儿结束刚刚好。

lines.en: $ chikaspring6 = True
$ chika_love += 1
jump chikaspring7
